knownDataCaveats: ATTENDANCE IS RECORDABLE BUT ALMOST NEVER RECORDED. The no-show status WORKS and has been used on exactly one of 21 appointments, verified 2026-07-29. So this is a five percent RECORDING rate, not a broken field and not a platform limitation. A low or zero show rate is therefore a recording gap and must NOT be read as evidence that patients are failing to attend; any claim about the show rate itself is unsupported. The workflow that would capture a consultation outcome was specified and deliberately deferred. Because the field demonstrably works, capturing an attendance answer is an AVAILABLE fix rather than an impossibility, and may be proposed as one. An earlier version of this note called attendance STRUCTURALLY UNMEASURABLE and said no automation can write an appointment outcome; the evidence disproved both and they were removed.

There are TWO calendars and they are deliberately different machines. The in-clinic calendar auto-confirms. The MOBILE calendar is manual-confirm ON PURPOSE: the client requests a time, then the owner confirms whether the suburb is reachable, so a mobile booking legitimately sits unconfirmed for a while. A mobile appointment that is still `new` or `confirmed` after its own start time reflects that two-phase design plus the missing outcome marking above, and must NOT be read as a stale-record defect on its own.

Opportunity `monetaryValue` IS being populated on this account, at the treatment price (A$99 and A$150 were observed live), so revenue here is genuinely readable rather than blank. Judge the coverage from the evidence rather than assuming either full or absent population.

NO DEPOSIT IS TAKEN on either calendar. Both booking flows state that no upfront deposit is required. A held deposit is the standard lever on no-shows for this kind of clinic, so its absence is a real structural fact about the account and not an oversight to be reported as if it were already configured.

The Voice AI agent IS LIVE ON INBOUND. Verified against the account 2026-07-29: agent 'Sky' reads agentStatus ACTIVE with inbound active on +61481610656, which is the same number 02 Missed Call Text Back filters on. A second agent, 'Sky Outbound (Speed-to-Lead)', is ACTIVE with no inbound number, and outbound calls appear in the week's conversations. An earlier version of this note said the voice agent was BUILT BUT DELIBERATELY SWITCHED OFF with no inbound number assigned, and that was WRONG. 🔴 WHETHER inbound voice was switched on deliberately is NOT settled: treat neither 'this is intended' nor 'this is an accident' as given, and say which you are assuming if a finding depends on it.

This account carries TEST DATA that has NOT been filtered out of the evidence. There is at least one internal test contact and a recurring SMS test loop used to drive the AI agents during the build. Nothing is redacted or excluded, deliberately, because a hole in the evidence is indistinguishable from a hole in the account. Discount obviously internal test traffic when reasoning, and say so when a number depends on it.
